name: CI

on:
  push:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  quality:
    name: Quality (${{ matrix.os }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}

    env:
      PYTHONUTF8: "1"
      PYTHONIOENCODING: utf-8

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os:
          - ubuntu-latest
          - windows-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v6

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: Set up Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "22"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: uv sync --dev

      - name: Run Ruff
        run: uv run ruff check .

      - name: Run tests
        run: uv run pytest

      - name: Check leaderboard selection
        run: node tests/test_leaderboard.cjs

      - name: Verify harness gold solutions
        run: uv run python .github/scripts/verify_gold_with_annotations.py

      - name: Build package
        run: uv build

      - name: Check package contents
        run: uv run python .github/scripts/check_package_contents.py

"""Offline contract of the native deepagents process boundary."""

import importlib.util
import json
import shlex
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace

from harness_bench import runner_openrouter


def test_isolated_route_preserves_model_configuration_and_exposes_only_runtime(monkeypatch):
    from harness_bench import runner_cli

    captured = {}
    monkeypatch.setattr(runner_openrouter, "_load_env_from_dotenv", lambda: None)
    monkeypatch.setattr(runner_openrouter, "_ensure_openrouter_key", lambda: None)
    monkeypatch.setattr(runner_openrouter, "_openrouter_api_key", lambda: "offline")

    def launch(*args, **kwargs):
        captured.update(kwargs)
        return []

    monkeypatch.setattr(runner_cli, "run_all_cli", launch)
    runner_openrouter.run_all(
        ["task_01_fake"],
        isolation="bwrap",
        model_name="original",
        recursion_limit=80,
        max_tokens=16384,
        harness_profile="gigachat",
        forward_reasoning_history=True,
        compact_at_tokens=100000,
        prompt_cache=True,
        no_subagents=True,
        responses_api=True,
        transient_attempts=5,
    )
    argv = shlex.split(captured["cli_command"])
    assert argv[argv.index("--model") + 1] == "original"
    assert argv[argv.index("--max-tokens") + 1] == "16384"
    assert argv[argv.index("--harness-profile") + 1] == "gigachat"
    assert all(
        flag in argv
        for flag in ("--forward-reasoning-history", "--prompt-cache", "--no-subagents", "--responses-api")
    )
    assert captured["transient_retries"] == 4
    paths = captured["runtime_paths"]
    package = Path(runner_openrouter.__file__).parent
    assert str(package) not in paths and str(package.parent) not in paths
    assert not any(Path(p).name.startswith(("tasks", "runner", "verifiers")) for p in paths)
    assert captured["extra_env_factory"]() == {"HBF_WORKER_API_KEY": "offline"}


def test_worker_invokes_same_builder_without_task_registry(monkeypatch, tmp_path, capsys):
    package = Path(runner_openrouter.__file__).parent
    monkeypatch.syspath_prepend(str(package))
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
        "offline_deepagents_worker", package / "deepagents_worker.py"
    )
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    captured = {}

    class FakeAgent:
        def invoke(self, payload, config):
            captured["payload"] = payload
            assert config["callbacks"]
            return {"messages": []}

    def build(workspace, **kwargs):
        captured.update(kwargs)
        return FakeAgent()

    monkeypatch.setitem(sys.modules, "openrouter_agent", SimpleNamespace(build_agent=build))
    monkeypatch.setenv("HBF_WORKER_API_KEY", "offline")
    monkeypatch.setenv("HBF_TASK_MIN_RECURSION_LIMIT", "90")
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        sys,
        "argv",
        [
            "worker",
            "--model",
            "test",
            "--max-tokens",
            "16384",
            "--forward-reasoning-history",
            "fixture",
        ],
    )
    assert module.main() == 0
    assert captured["forward_reasoning_history"] is True and captured["recursion_limit"] == 90
    assert captured["payload"] == {"messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "fixture"}]}
    events = [json.loads(line) for line in capsys.readouterr().out.splitlines()]
    assert events[-1]["type"] == "hbf_deepagents_result"
    assert events[-1]["stats"]["agent_compactions"] == 0


def test_explicit_reasoning_effort_reaches_native_model(monkeypatch, tmp_path):
    from harness_bench import chat_openai, openrouter_agent
    captured = {}
    class ModelBuilt(Exception):
        pass
    def model(**kwargs):
        captured.update(kwargs)
        raise ModelBuilt
    monkeypatch.setattr(chat_openai, "ReasoningAwareChatOpenAI", model)
    monkeypatch.setenv("OPENROUTER_REASONING_EFFORT", "medium")
    import pytest
    with pytest.raises(ModelBuilt):
        openrouter_agent.build_agent(tmp_path, api_key="offline", forward_reasoning_history=True)
    assert captured["reasoning_effort"] == "medium"
    assert captured["forward_reasoning_history"] is True
    monkeypatch.setenv("OPENROUTER_REASONING_EFFORT", "misspelled")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Unsupported OPENROUTER_REASONING_EFFORT"):
        openrouter_agent.build_agent(tmp_path, api_key="offline")


def test_responses_api_moves_effort_into_encrypted_reasoning(monkeypatch, tmp_path):
    import deepagents

    from harness_bench import openrouter_agent

    captured = {}

    class Agent:
        def with_config(self, config):
            return self

    def create(model, **kwargs):
        captured["model"] = model
        return Agent()

    monkeypatch.setattr(deepagents, "create_deep_agent", create)
    monkeypatch.setenv("OPENROUTER_REASONING_EFFORT", "high")
    openrouter_agent.build_agent(tmp_path, api_key="offline", model_name="openai/gpt-6-luna", responses_api=True)
    model = captured["model"]
    assert model.use_responses_api is True
    assert model.reasoning == {"effort": "high"} and model.reasoning_effort is None
    assert model.store is False and model.include == ["reasoning.encrypted_content"]

    openrouter_agent.build_agent(tmp_path, api_key="offline", model_name="z-ai/glm-5.3")
    model = captured["model"]
    assert not model.use_responses_api and model.reasoning_effort == "high"

"""Independent small-instance oracle and actual service execution."""

import itertools
import json
import random
from copy import deepcopy
from fractions import Fraction

import pytest

from harness_bench.feasibility_tasks.hard_search import (
    assess,
    build_pairs,
    coverage,
    make_task,
    optimize,
    ratio,
    remaining,
    service,
    target,
    total,
)
from harness_bench.feasibility_tasks.trusted_service import get_session, trusted_service_available
from harness_bench.reflect_tasks.common import call

PAIRS = build_pairs()
require_unix_service = pytest.mark.skipif(
    not trusted_service_available(), reason="Unix-socket host service unavailable"
)


def brute(spec, qb, ib):
    # All subsets, including overlapping routes: independently validates the
    # dominance reduction to one route per shard used by production DP.
    best = 0
    routes = spec["routes"]
    for bits in itertools.product((False, True), repeat=len(routes)):
        selected = [r for r, bit in zip(routes, bits, strict=True) if bit]
        if any(r["id"] not in spec["enabled"] for r in selected):
            continue
        if sum(r["query_cost"] for r in selected) > qb or sum(r["io_cost"] for r in selected) > ib:
            continue
        members = {
            (r["shard"], i)
            for r in selected
            for i in range(min(r["prefix"], spec["population"][r["shard"]]))
        }
        best = max(best, len(members))
    return best


def test_two_quota_dp_against_exhaustive_actual_records():
    rng = random.Random(9177)
    for _ in range(40):
        spec = dict(population={"a": 5, "b": 7, "c": 4}, routes=[], enabled=[])
        for i in range(8):
            spec["routes"].append(
                dict(
                    id=str(i),
                    shard=rng.choice("abc"),
                    prefix=rng.randrange(1, 10),
                    query_cost=rng.randrange(1, 4),
                    io_cost=rng.randrange(1, 5),
                )
            )
        spec["enabled"] = [str(i) for i in range(8) if rng.randrange(4)]
        q, b = rng.randrange(2, 10), rng.randrange(2, 12)
        value, ids = optimize(spec, q, b)
        assert value == brute(spec, q, b)
        assert coverage(spec, ids) == value


@pytest.mark.parametrize("pair", PAIRS, ids=lambda p: p["slug"])
def test_controls_and_exact_threshold(pair):
    pos, neg = pair["positive"], pair["negative"]
    assert Fraction(optimize(pos, *remaining(pos))[0], total(pos)) >= Fraction(95, 100)
    assert Fraction(optimize(neg, *remaining(neg))[0], total(neg)) < Fraction(95, 100)
    assert {k for k in pos if pos[k] != neg[k]} == {"query_budget"}


@pytest.mark.parametrize("pair", PAIRS, ids=lambda p: p["slug"])
@pytest.mark.parametrize("side", ["positive", "negative"])
@require_unix_service
def test_gold_actual_closed_client_and_replay(pair, side, tmp_path):
    task = make_task(999, pair, pair[side])
    task.setup(tmp_path)
    assert not task.verify(tmp_path).passed
    task.apply_gold(tmp_path)
    result = task.verify(tmp_path)
    assert result.passed, result.message
    metrics = json.loads(result.message)["wave19"]
    assert metrics["decision_correct"] and metrics["extra_requests"] == 0


def send(ws, client, command, payload):
    (ws / "answer.json").write_text(json.dumps(payload))
    response, code = call(ws, client, command, "--file", "answer.json")
    assert code == 0, response


@require_unix_service
def test_verified_lucky_find_without_plan_is_accepted(tmp_path):
    spec = deepcopy(PAIRS[0]["negative"])
    shard, offset, found = target(spec)
    r = next(
        r
        for r in spec["routes"]
        if r["shard"] == shard
        and r["prefix"] > offset
        and r["query_cost"] <= spec["query_budget"]
        and r["io_cost"] <= spec["io_budget"]
    )
    task = make_task(999, PAIRS[0], spec)
    client = service("999", spec)
    task.setup(tmp_path)
    response, code = call(tmp_path, client, "probe", "--route", r["id"])
    assert code == 0 and response["found_id"] == found
    send(tmp_path, client, "finish", {"found_id": found})
    assert task.verify(tmp_path).passed
    state = get_session(tmp_path).replay().state
    ok, metrics = assess(spec, state)
    assert ok and metrics["success_basis"] == "verified_find"
    assert not metrics["strategy_correct"]


@require_unix_service
def test_missing_diagnostics_cannot_be_replaced_by_guessed_numbers(tmp_path):
    pair = next(p for p in PAIRS if p["slug"] == "search_count")
    spec = pair["negative"]
    task = make_task(999, pair, spec)
    client = service("999", spec)
    task.setup(tmp_path)
    p = Fraction(optimize(spec)[0], total(spec))
    send(tmp_path, client, "plan", dict(decision="stop", routes=[], success_probability=ratio(p)))
    send(tmp_path, client, "finish", {"found_id": None})
    result = task.verify(tmp_path)
    assert not result.passed and "diagnostics" in result.message


@require_unix_service
def test_unlucky_tail_passes_and_forged_probabilities_do_not(tmp_path):
    spec = deepcopy(PAIRS[4]["positive"])
    best, ids = optimize(spec, *remaining(spec))
    assert Fraction(95, 100) <= Fraction(best, total(spec)) < 1
    selected = {r["shard"]: r["prefix"] for r in spec["routes"] if r["id"] in ids}
    for seed in range(1000):
        spec["target_seed"] = seed
        s, rank, _ = target(spec)
        if rank >= selected.get(s, 0):
            break
    else:
        raise AssertionError("no unlucky draw")
    task = make_task(999, PAIRS[4], spec)
    task.setup(tmp_path)
    task.apply_gold(tmp_path)
    state = get_session(tmp_path).replay().state
    assert state["found"] is None and task.verify(tmp_path).passed
    state["plan"]["success_probability"] = [1, 1]
    assert not assess(spec, state)[0]
    state["plan"]["success_probability"] = ratio(Fraction(best, total(spec)))
    state["finish"] = {"found_id": "invented"}
    assert not assess(spec, state)[0]


@pytest.mark.parametrize("quota", ["query_budget", "io_budget"])
@require_unix_service
def test_lucky_find_does_not_override_quota_errors(tmp_path, quota):
    spec = deepcopy(PAIRS[0]["positive"])
    task = make_task(999, PAIRS[0], spec)
    task.setup(tmp_path)
    task.apply_gold(tmp_path)
    state = get_session(tmp_path).replay().state
    state["query_used" if quota == "query_budget" else "io_used"] = spec[quota] + 1
    assert not assess(spec, state)[0]

name: Windows benchmark smoke

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      runner:
        description: "Benchmark runner to execute"
        required: true
        default: "run-cli"
        type: choice
        options:
          - run
          - run-pure
          - run-openrouter
          - run-cli
      tasks:
        description: "Task ids separated by comma, space, or newline"
        required: true
        type: string
        default: "task_111_xlsx_extract_b2, task_112_xlsx_sum_column, task_113_xlsx_update_cell, task_123_sqlite_count, task_124_sqlite_sum, task_148_csv_to_xlsx, task_149_sqlite_to_json, task_152_sqlite_join_to_json, task_153_xlsx_to_markdown_report, task_154_jsonl_into_sqlite, task_158_xlsx_split_sheets, task_191_sqlite_revenue_report, task_196_xlsx_to_csv_and_json, task_199_sqlite_filtered_export, task_203_sqlite_team_markdown_report, task_207_inventory_anomaly_report, task_219_sql_paid_leaderboard"
      recursion_limit:
        description: "Agent recursion limit for in-process deepagents runners"
        required: true
        default: "80"
        type: string
      openrouter_model:
        description: "Model id for run-openrouter"
        required: true
        default: "qwen/qwen3.6-plus"
        type: string
      cli_command:
        description: "Command prefix for run-cli; the task prompt is appended by the benchmark"
        required: false
        default: "cmd /c npx -y opencode-ai@latest run --model openrouter/qwen/qwen3.6-plus"
        type: string
      cli_timeout:
        description: "Per-task timeout in seconds for run-cli"
        required: true
        default: "900"
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  windows-benchmark-smoke:
    name: Windows real benchmark smoke (${{ inputs.runner }})
    runs-on: windows-latest
    timeout-minutes: 180

    env:
      PYTHONUTF8: "1"
      PYTHONIOENCODING: "utf-8"
      UV_SYSTEM_PYTHON: "0"
      # Keep --keep workspaces inside the checkout so they can be uploaded.
      TEMP: ${{ github.workspace }}\\.bench-tmp
      TMP: ${{ github.workspace }}\\.bench-tmp
      # GigaChat path: `run` and `run-pure`.
      GIGACHAT_CREDENTIALS: ${{ secrets.GIGACHAT_CREDENTIALS }}
      GIGACHAT_USER: ${{ secrets.GIGACHAT_USER }}
      GIGACHAT_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.GIGACHAT_PASSWORD }}
      GIGACHAT_BASE_URL: ${{ secrets.GIGACHAT_BASE_URL }}
      GIGACHAT_MODEL: ${{ vars.GIGACHAT_MODEL || 'GigaChat-3-Ultra' }}
      GIGACHAT_SCOPE: ${{ vars.GIGACHAT_SCOPE }}
      GIGACHAT_VERIFY_SSL_CERTS: ${{ vars.GIGACHAT_VERIFY_SSL_CERTS }}
      # OpenRouter path: `run-openrouter` and the default `run-cli` command.
      OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}
      OPENROUTER_BASE_URL: ${{ vars.OPENROUTER_BASE_URL }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v6

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "22"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: uv sync --dev

      - name: Preflight selected runner
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $env:TEMP | Out-Null

          foreach ($name in @("GIGACHAT_BASE_URL", "GIGACHAT_MODEL", "GIGACHAT_SCOPE", "GIGACHAT_VERIFY_SSL_CERTS", "OPENROUTER_BASE_URL")) {
            if ((Test-Path "Env:\\$name") -and -not (Get-Item "Env:\\$name").Value) {
              Remove-Item "Env:\\$name"
            }
          }

          $runner = "${{ inputs.runner }}"
          Write-Host "Runner: $runner"
          uv run python -m harness_bench list | Select-Object -First 20

          if ($runner -in @("run", "run-pure")) {
            if (-not $env:GIGACHAT_CREDENTIALS -and -not (($env:GIGACHAT_USER) -and ($env:GIGACHAT_PASSWORD))) {
              throw "Runner '$runner' requires GIGACHAT_CREDENTIALS or GIGACHAT_USER + GIGACHAT_PASSWORD repository secrets."
            }
          }

          if ($runner -eq "run-openrouter") {
            if (-not $env:OPENROUTER_API_KEY) {
              throw "Runner 'run-openrouter' requires OPENROUTER_API_KEY repository secret."
            }
          }

          if ($runner -eq "run-cli") {
            $cliCommand = "${{ inputs.cli_command }}"
            Write-Host "CLI command: $cliCommand"
            node --version
            npm --version
            if ($cliCommand -match "(?i)openrouter" -and -not $env:OPENROUTER_API_KEY) {
              throw "Runner 'run-cli' with an OpenRouter-backed CLI command requires OPENROUTER_API_KEY repository secret."
            }
          }

      - name: Run benchmark smoke
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"
          foreach ($name in @("GIGACHAT_BASE_URL", "GIGACHAT_MODEL", "GIGACHAT_SCOPE", "GIGACHAT_VERIFY_SSL_CERTS", "OPENROUTER_BASE_URL")) {
            if ((Test-Path "Env:\\$name") -and -not (Get-Item "Env:\\$name").Value) {
              Remove-Item "Env:\\$name"
            }
          }

          $runner = "${{ inputs.runner }}"
          $tasksText = @'
          ${{ inputs.tasks }}
          '@
          $tasks = $tasksText -split "[,\s]+" |
            ForEach-Object { $_.Trim() } |
            Where-Object { $_ -and -not $_.StartsWith("#") }

          if (-not $tasks) {
            throw "No benchmark tasks selected."
          }

          $benchArgs = @("-m", "harness_bench", $runner)
          foreach ($task in $tasks) {
            $benchArgs += @("--task", $task)
          }
          $benchArgs += @("--keep", "--allow-task-failures")

          if ($runner -in @("run", "run-pure", "run-openrouter")) {
            $benchArgs += @("--recursion-limit", "${{ inputs.recursion_limit }}")
          }
          if ($runner -eq "run-openrouter") {
            $benchArgs += @("--model", "${{ inputs.openrouter_model }}")
          }
          if ($runner -eq "run-cli") {
            $benchArgs += @("--cli-command", "${{ inputs.cli_command }}", "--timeout", "${{ inputs.cli_timeout }}")
          }

          Write-Host "uv run python $($benchArgs -join ' ')"
          uv run python @benchArgs
          $exitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
          Write-Host "Benchmark exit code: $exitCode"

          Write-Host "Workspace directories kept under $env:TEMP:"
          if (Test-Path $env:TEMP) {
            Get-ChildItem -Path $env:TEMP -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
              Select-Object -ExpandProperty FullName
          }

          exit $exitCode

      - name: Upload kept benchmark workspaces
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: windows-benchmark-workspaces-${{ inputs.runner }}
          path: .bench-tmp/**
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 7

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
import unittest

from helpers import make_db
from stockroom import orders, pricing
from stockroom.errors import ValidationError
from stockroom.money import D


class PricingTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.db = make_db()

    def test_retail_price_without_discounts(self):
        a = pricing.line_amounts(self.db, "MILK", 1, "C1")
        self.assertEqual((a["unit"], a["net"], a["vat"], a["total"]), (D("89.90"), D("89.90"), D("8.99"), D("98.89")))

    def test_wholesale_then_personal_discount(self):
        self.assertEqual(pricing.unit_price(self.db, "MILK", 1, "C2"), D("76.86"))

    def test_quantity_breaks(self):
        self.assertEqual(pricing.qty_break(self.db, "TEA", 9), D(0))
        self.assertEqual(pricing.unit_price(self.db, "TEA", 9, "C1"), D("350.00"))
        self.assertEqual(pricing.unit_price(self.db, "TEA", 10, "C1"), D("332.50"))
        self.assertEqual(pricing.unit_price(self.db, "TEA", 50, "C1"), D("315.00"))

    def test_all_rules_together(self):
        a = pricing.line_amounts(self.db, "TEA", 60, "C3")
        self.assertEqual(a["unit"], D("305.55"))
        self.assertEqual(a["net"], D("18333.00"))
        self.assertEqual(a["vat"], D("3666.60"))
        self.assertEqual(a["vat_rate"], D("20"))

    def test_weighted_goods_round_line_sum(self):
        a = pricing.line_amounts(self.db, "SUGAR", "1.237", "C3")
        self.assertEqual(a["unit"], D("70.33"))
        self.assertEqual(a["net"], D("87.00"))

    def test_order_amounts_are_sums_of_lines(self):
        order = orders.create_order(self.db, "C2", "2024-03-06", ["MILK:12", "TEA:10", "BREAD:3"])
        amounts = pricing.order_amounts(self.db, order)
        self.assertEqual(len(amounts["lines"]), 3)
        self.assertEqual(amounts["net"], sum((l["net"] for l in amounts["lines"]), D(0)))
        self.assertEqual(amounts["total"], amounts["net"] + amounts["vat"])
        self.assertEqual(pricing.order_total(self.db, order["id"]), amounts["total"])

    def test_breaks_validation(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValidationError):
            pricing.set_breaks(self.db, "MILK", ["10-5"])
        with self.assertRaises(ValidationError):
            pricing.set_breaks(self.db, "MILK", ["10:100"])
        with self.assertRaises(ValidationError):
            pricing.set_breaks(self.db, "MILK", ["10:5", "10:7"])
        rows = pricing.set_breaks(self.db, "MILK", [("24", "3"), ("12", "2")])
        self.assertEqual([r["min_qty"] for r in rows], ["12", "24"])

    def test_price_list(self):
        rows = pricing.price_list(self.db, "C2")
        self.assertEqual([r["sku"] for r in rows], ["BREAD", "MILK", "SUGAR", "TEA"])
        self.assertEqual(rows[1]["price"], "76.86")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

[project]
name = "harness-bench-fast"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "Self-contained 471-task agent benchmark (file ops, code edits, data pipelines, memory, agentic, adversarial, and terminal workflows)"
readme = "README.md"
requires-python = ">=3.12"
license = "MIT"
authors = [
    { name = "AI Forever" },
]
keywords = ["benchmark", "agent", "deepagents", "langchain", "evaluation", "harness"]
classifiers = [
    "Development Status :: 3 - Alpha",
    "Intended Audience :: Developers",
    "License :: OSI Approved :: MIT License",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.12",
    "Topic :: Scientific/Engineering :: Artificial Intelligence",
]
dependencies = [
    # Benchmark reproducibility: agent-harness libraries are pinned exactly (==).
    # Bumping any of them is a deliberate, result-affecting change.
    "deepagents==0.6.12",
    # Several benchmark tasks are verified by running `python -m pytest`.
    "pytest>=9.0.2",
    "python-dotenv>=1.2.2",
    # Used by xlsx-related tasks (verifiers and gold fixtures).
    "openpyxl>=3.1",
    # Used by YAML-related task fixtures and verifiers.
    "PyYAML>=6.0",
    # Required on Windows runners for zoneinfo-based timezone gold checks.
    "tzdata>=2025.2",
]

[project.optional-dependencies]
# `uv pip install harness-bench-fast[gigachat]` for running against GigaChat
# through `runner.py`. The optional harness profile ships separately and is
# auto-detected when installed.
gigachat = [
    "langchain-gigachat==0.5.1",
]
# Public profile extra. For exact v9/v10 result reproduction, install the
# matching local deepagents-gigachat wheel/source described in README.md.
gigachat-profile = [
    "langchain-gigachat==0.5.1",
    "deepagents-gigachat==0.0.4",
]
# `uv pip install harness-bench-fast[openrouter]` for `runner_openrouter.py`
# against any OpenAI-compatible OpenRouter model.
openrouter = [
    "langchain-openai==1.2.2",
]

[project.urls]
Homepage = "https://github.com/ai-forever/harness-bench-fast"
Repository = "https://github.com/ai-forever/harness-bench-fast"
Issues = "https://github.com/ai-forever/harness-bench-fast/issues"

[build-system]
requires = ["hatchling"]
build-backend = "hatchling.build"

[tool.hatch.build.targets.sdist]
include = [
    "/harness_bench",
    "/LICENSE",
    "/README.md",
    "/pyproject.toml",
    "/tests",
]
exclude = [
    "/.github",
    "/.gitignore",
    "/.venv",
    "/dist",
    "/uv.lock",
    "/harness_bench/runs",
    "/harness_bench/.free-code-logs",
    "/.free-code-logs",
]

[tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel]
packages = ["harness_bench"]

[dependency-groups]
dev = [
    "ruff>=0.15.12",
    "langchain-openai==1.2.2",
    "langchain-gigachat==0.5.1",
    "deepagents-gigachat==0.0.4",
]

[tool.ruff]
line-length = 100
target-version = "py312"

[tool.ruff.lint]
select = ["E", "F", "I", "UP", "B", "SIM"]
ignore = ["E501"]

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
norecursedirs = [
    ".git",
    ".venv",
    "dist",
    "harbor_dataset*",
    "harbor_jobs*",
    "jobs",
]
